recipes.story_shape: One creator introduces a collection of interconnected tools or capabilities
recipes.layout: Large presenter on one side; organized collection of product tiles on the other
when_not_to_use: Single-feature demonstrations
Videos without a genuine collection of tools
Topics where application tiles would become illegible

recipes.story_shape: A human creator demonstrates or explains one specific software product
recipes.layout: Large authentic interface with overlapping presenter portrait
when_not_to_use: Products without usable screenshots
Complex interfaces that cannot be simplified
Stories where the software itself is not central

recipes.story_shape: A human creator moves from a recognizable problem to a better working situation
recipes.layout: Left-to-right before-and-after comparison with a prominent directional transition
recipes.presenter_role: Concerned before; confident or enthusiastic after
required_assets: Approved presenter portraits or reviewed variations
Result illustration or authentic product imagery
when_not_to_use: Stories without a meaningful transformation
Cases where the result is unverified
Topics requiring a detailed technical explanation

recipes.story_shape: A measurable or observable technical problem becomes a better technical result
recipes.layout: Presenter on one side; stacked diagnostic comparisons on the other
required_assets: Authentic or explicitly illustrative diagnostic data
when_not_to_use: Stories without comparable outputs
Cases where fabricated measurements might be mistaken for real data
Topics with no clear visual diagnostic

recipes.story_shape: One agent or tool coordinates multiple processing operations
recipes.layout: Central product or agent hero with simplified input-to-output flow
when_not_to_use: Agents without an approved visual identity
Pipelines too complicated to simplify accurately
Videos primarily about human experiences

recipes.story_shape: A tool detects or highlights a specific problem that the viewer should notice
recipes.layout: Human reaction beside one dominant diagnostic warning
when_not_to_use: Stories without a genuine detectable problem
Cases where warning graphics exaggerate the severity
Topics requiring several equally important explanations

recipes.story_shape: A technical system identifies, measures or understands something visually
recipes.layout: One large subject with a simple technical overlay
required_assets: Verified overlay geometry or clearly illustrative annotations
when_not_to_use: Features that cannot be represented with simple annotations
Cases where the overlay would obscure the subject
Claims requiring proof that a static illustration cannot provide

recipes.story_shape: A creator introduces a real demonstration that provides evidence of a technical capability
recipes.layout: Creator portrait beside an authentic demonstration frame
when_not_to_use: Stories without authentic demonstration footage
Examples requiring unverified claims
Demonstrations too visually complicated for thumbnail scale

recipes.story_shape: A sequence of processing steps produces one or more visible outputs
recipes.layout: Left-to-right sequence of simplified process frames feeding output icons
recipes.presenter_role: Optional; repeated frames may replace a hero portrait
when_not_to_use: Processes that cannot be simplified visually
Stories without meaningful outputs
Topics where multiple small frames become illegible
